ND Cycling Hall of Fame Gala
events.description:
🎄🚴 ND CYCLING HALL OF FAME GALA 🚴🎄 ✨ Honoring the Legends. Celebrating the Journey. Keeping the Wheels Turning. ✨

Join us in Medora during Cowboy Christmas Week for a special evening celebrating the inaugural class of the North Dakota Cycling Hall of Fame!

🏆 HONORING OUR 2026 INDUCTEES Celebrate the athletes, advocates, community builders, industry leaders, and young cyclists who have helped shape the history and future of cycling in North Dakota.

🎉 AN EVENING FULL OF HOLIDAY CHEER!

🎶 Live music 🥔 Hot potato bar ☕ Hot cocoa bar 📸 Festive photo booth 🎁 Door prizes 🔨 Silent auction 🏆 Recognition of our 2026 Hall of Fame inductees 🚲 Special display featuring the North Dakota Cycling Hall of Fame inductees and a historical bicycle collection

📅 Friday, December 4, 2026 🕔 5:00–7:00 PM 📍 Dakota Cycling Adventures 365 Main Street, Medora, North Dakota

Our gala is part of the excitement of Cowboy Christmas Week, making it the perfect opportunity to celebrate cycling, connect with fellow outdoor enthusiasts, and enjoy the holiday spirit in the Badlands!

And the fun doesn't stop there! Join the cycling community the following day for the St. Nick Fat Tire Bike Race hosted by our friends at Save the Maah Daah Hey and enjoy Medora’s Cowboy Christmas…Make a weekend of it!

🎟️ REGISTER TODAY — SEATING IS LIMITED! Don't miss this special opportunity to honor North Dakota's cycling legends and celebrate the future of our sport.

Let's come together to celebrate the people, trails, and communities that keep North Dakota cycling strong!

events.title: Clay Sculpting Open Studio -December
events.description:
Clay Sculpting Open Studio 👐✨ Join us for a hands-on Clay Sculpting Open Studio where creativity takes shape! Each person receives 1 pound of clay included in the $45 price, with the option to add extra clay for $10 per additional pound.

This is a hand-building experience only—no pottery wheel—just your hands, your imagination, and the tools we provide. Create anything you can dream up! Once your sculpture is complete, we’ll take care of the rest. Your piece will be professionally fired in our kiln, and when it’s ready, you’re invited to return during a Paint Your Own Pottery Open Studio to glaze your creation. This experience is perfect for both kids and adults, whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned maker.

All firings are included in the price, so you can focus on having fun and bringing your ideas to life. ✨ The ideas are limitless—come get your hands dirty and create something truly unique! ✨

events.title: Jingle Bell 5K
events.description:
Join Us for Our Holiday-Spirited Annual 5K Run/Walk! 🎄

Kick off the season with fun, fitness, and holiday cheer! Dress in your favorite festive attire and jingle all the way—every participant will receive bells to wear during the race.

After crossing the finish line, warm up with hot cocoa and a hearty bowl of chili, and stick around for your chance to win Best Dressed!

Strollers and pets are welcome, so bring the whole family!

REGISTRATION DETAILS:

Early Registration on or before Nov. 18 | $25/adult \(19\+\) or $15 \(youth 6-18\)

Registration after Nov. 18 | $35/adult \(19\+\) or $20 \(youth 6-18\)

5 & under are free.

REGISTER HERE

RACE CHECK-IN: Saturday, December 5 | 9:30-10:15 am | WRCC

RACE START: 10:30 am

PRIZES: 1st, 2nd and 3rd place prizes will be given to the best dressed individual after the race.

Check out these fun photos from past events!

events.description:
🎨 Open Studio at Long X Art Center Looking for a creative space to paint, draw, and connect? Join us for Open Studio, a relaxed time for artists of all levels to create, share ideas, and enjoy being part of a supportive art community.

Bring your own project, or start something new using our watercolor, oil paint, acrylic, graphite, or charcoal supplies. This is a non-instructional, self-guided session — but Oksana will be around if you need a little help or feedback along the way. We will have tea available free of charge, also something playing on the tv! If you suggestions, please let us know! Whether you’re just getting started or have years of experience, everyone is welcome here.

Being an artist can sometimes feel lonely, but creating together helps us all grow and stay inspired. By donation • All are welcome Come as you are, create what you love, and enjoy the company of fellow artists. 💛

events.description:
Dickinson Parks and Recreation invites you to bring the entire family to our annual New Years’ Eve ice skating party! We will have both the Cornerstone and Charbonneau rinks open! Get geared up to ring in the new year by skating to a live DJ and lights on ice. Door Prizes will be drawn throughout the event \(must be present to win\). Free food and non-alcoholic beverage will be served.

TIME: 6:00-9:00 pm

FEE: Free Admission / $3 Skate Rental

Doors open at 5:45 pm.

events.title: Teen After Hours: NYE Party Edition
events.description:
Get ready to ring in the new year with an unforgettable night packed with excitement, fun, and memories! This New Year’s Eve celebration is specially designed for middle school and high school students to say goodbye to 2026 and welcome 2027 in the best way possible—with friends, tons of activities, and an energetic vibe in a safe and exciting environment.

Whether you’re shooting hoops on the basketball court, spiking the ball in volleyball, battling it out in laser tag, or leveling up in video games, there’s something for everyone. Plus, enjoy a variety of tasty appetizers and refreshing drinks throughout the night!

When the clock strikes midnight, gather with us to watch the ball drop in style and celebrate the start of a brand new year with your friends. Don’t miss out on the ultimate way to kick off a new year!

Open to all teens in grades 6-12.
